description: This file is a server-side entry point for a Remix application, handling server requests by rendering React components to a stream, including special handling for bots via isbot detection, and setting appropriate response headers for CORS and content type.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main handler function that processes incoming requests, detects if the request is from a bot or a browser, and delegates to appropriate handling functions.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests identified as originating from bots, streaming pre-rendered React components directly.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from browsers, streaming React components with a different flow compared to bot requests.
